query: If I hold a fund under the CPF Investment Scheme that does not meet the stricter criteria, when must I exercise the switching option?
reference_answer: Funds that are unable to meet the stricter criteria can only take in new CPF monies till December 2010, and you will be given up till 30 June 2011 to exercise the switching option.In addition, a fund may decide to cease taking in new CPF monies earlier. If this happens, you have to exercise the switching option within the timeframe stipulated by the Fund Management Company/insurer in its communication letter to you.

New funds will continue to be evaluated according to existing evaluation factors. However, new funds will have to meet a higher benchmark, and henceforth funds admitted to CPF Investment Scheme will be among the top 25 percentile of funds. In addition, new funds will have to meet an expense ratio criterion pegged at the median of all funds in the same risk class. New funds should preferably also have a track record of at least 3-years.Supplementary InformationThe specific aspects of the investment process that are looked at during the evaluation process for Unit Trusts and Investment-Linked Insurance Policies include the following:Investment Philosophy;Key Decision Makers;Research and Analysis;Portfolio Construction;Implementation/Trading; andPast Performance.

In this way, members will not be worse off than leaving their monies in the CPF Accounts.

You then have until June 2011 to exercise the switching option.
